newsitem.title: UK: UK Jarvis 15-mth pretax profits 15 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK Jarvis 15-mth pretax profits 15 mln stg.

text.p: British facilities management and construction property group Jarvis Plc said on Thursday its pre-tax profits for the 15-month period to March 31, 1997 stood at 15.2 million stg.

The company, which acquired Jarvis Facilities (formerly Northern Infrastructure Maintenance Company Ltd) last year saw its turnover rise to 261.2 million stg from 76.4 million in 12 months to December, 1995.
Pre-tax profit was 500,000 stg in the 12 months to December 1995.
Earnings per share stood at 15.6 pence against 1.2p in 1995 and the company proposed a final dividend of 4.0 pence per share, for a total dividend of 5.6 pence per share.
The company also announced acquisitions of two track renewal companies -- Fastline Ltd and Relayfast Ltd -- for 55 million stg.
Jarvis expects the acquisitions to enhance its earnings considerably next year.
